entities.summary: N'Faly Dante is a Malian professional basketball player, who most recently played for the Atlanta Hawks of the National Basketball Association (NBA). He played college basketball for the Oregon Ducks. He was a five-star recruit who attended Sunrise Christian Academy in Bel Aire, Kansas.
